title: kate-ui: load every vendored definition at launch
summary: load_repository in session.rs lists five xml files by hand and misses ansic89.xml. It now calls kate_syntax::vendored_repository, so every wired definition reaches the window. The highlighter lookup and the theme stay as they are. This is the only kate-ui packet in the wiring plan.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. session.rs is a macOS-only module and its tests need the GPUI build. The owner checks that a C file opens with color.

definitions.definition:
/// Every vendored definition, parsed and linked once.
fn load_repository() -> Repository

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Replace the five include_str lines and the loop in load_repository with kate_syntax::vendored_repository().expect("vendored definitions link"). Remove the add_xml loop and the link call there. shared_repository, themed_workspace, and highlighter_for stay unchanged. session.rs has a test module named tests. Add the new test at the end of that module. Do not write a second mod tests. The test the_shared_repository_holds_ansi_c89 asserts shared_repository().by_name("ANSI C89") is Some and shared_repository().by_name("Rust") is Some. The existing tests stay green. Branch from the current tip of main. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 30 lines.

regression_tests.name: session::tests::the_shared_repository_holds_ansi_c89
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because load_repository lists five files and ansic89.xml is not one of them. After the change by_name of ANSI C89 is Some.
